corpus_provenance: Author-written public issue texts fixed before feature encoding or evaluation. No private profile data, benchmark-dataset claim, held-out tuning, or external model inference service.

evaluation_policy.cryptographic_run: Fresh setup and fresh operations. --resume reuses completed request results or resumes the same incomplete request through core; it never relabels reused proof files as newly generated.
evaluation_policy.lifecycle: Each operation executes in a separate OS process against the same durable core.Live root. A named restart checkpoint records another successful reopen; the following repeated query must match every lane and ranking of the pre-restart query.
evaluation_policy.prediction: Descending exact rational mean of eight-lane squared dot products over retained examples; alphabetical tie break.
evaluation_policy.scope: Public author-written issue-routing workload. Full reader remains. Finite held-out accuracy is an executed utility observation, not general task accuracy or privacy evidence.

feature_profile: Existing frozen local E5 TextEncoder; 576 integer coordinates in [-32,32], squared norm <=20000. Class labels are never encoder inputs.
